name: Create Worker Route
description: Create Worker Route Creates a route that maps a URL pattern to a Worker. POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/workers/routes
context:
POST /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/workers/routes
Creates a route that maps a URL pattern to a Worker.
Required: zone_id (path); body (body)

name: Delete Worker Route
description: Delete Worker Route Deletes a Worker route. DELETE /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/workers/routes/{route_id}

name: Get Worker Route
description: Get Worker Route Returns information about a Worker route, including URL pattern and Worker. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/workers/routes/{route_id}

name: List Worker Routes
description: List Worker Routes Returns Worker routes for a zone. GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/workers/routes
context:
GET /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/workers/routes
Returns Worker routes for a zone.
Required: zone_id (path)

name: Replace Worker Route
description: Replace Worker Route Replaces the URL pattern or Worker associated with a Worker route. PUT /client/v4/zones/{zone_id}/workers/routes/{route_id}
